data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first payment reminder (1. Mahnung) for the annual "Muster Magazin" subscription (Abo-Nummer AB-5541078), demanding EUR 61.90 (EUR 59.40 outstanding subscription fee plus EUR 2.50 dunning fee) to be paid by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: This is a first reminder (Mahnung) from the publisher because the annual fee for your magazine subscription has not been received. A EUR 2.50 late fee has already been added to the original EUR 59.40, making a total of EUR 61.90. Transfer this amount to the IBAN shown by the stated deadline to avoid further reminders or additional fees. If you already paid, the letter tells you to disregard it. Keep proof of payment in case of a dispute.
